decisions.text: Non-disclosure is scoped to first-factor failures. Second-factor mfa_failed and per-account rate_limited reasons are allowed, still without any target. The engine cannot attribute them to an account: later contract-field design input.
A catalog addition is nominated only for a real MISREPRESENTS signal, never for mere SDK acceptance or STRAINED fit.
Owner workstation macOS Apple Silicon, external Node 26, governed distributable kit at exact approved head, permission-constrained probe, driver provenance. No build permission implies S1.
Orchestrator may delegate S1 only under the recorded G39 terms after exact-head verification. G20/G34 limits and S2 remain unchanged; this file approves no run.

implementer_defaults.text: Record preservation of host-supplied request and correlation IDs on K1 and K2a as a host-side join possibility, not SDK attribution. Whether forbidden is deferred to consumer profile #806.
Define no resource.change_categories vocabulary: it would redefine a contract field. Record no registry, no enum, no item maxLength, objects allowed.
Record login acceptance versus logout/contact/lockout/rotation refusal as asymmetry, not a new profile constraint.
Record actor.id/subject.id equality plus authorization.decision and the per-path hook-keying caveat; define no new hook policy.
Record transaction_critical session.revoked fail-closed posture as a containment finding. Capturing-sink acceptance proves no durability guarantees.
Analysis only: lazy TTL release has no commit point; host would have to synthesize one. U1 scheduled variant has an explicit synthetic commit.

Begin the handle before the request, link public operation/correlation getters without passing the transactional handle to the request, then markCommitted and emit completion with real recovery-handler policy context.

One sequential process, baseline-inclusive predicted count 623, allowance 1246 (2x), cap 5000. All constructors, factories, public methods and sink callbacks count; drift inside allowance is a note, sticky exhaustion stops.

rubric.FITS: Catalog purpose, trigger or investigation covers the signal; every field keeps its contract meaning
rubric.STRAINED: Contract-legal and trust/authority retained, but purpose does not name the signal or a field meaning is stretched
rubric.MISREPRESENTS: Requires contradicting field trust/authority, a catalog resource/actor rule, or lifecycle/commit semantics

best_candidate_rule: Each signal uses its best SDK-accepted honest expression under the rubric; required contact/password/API/factor components cannot substitute for each other. S-CRIT2 PASS iff all six signals are conclusive and none MISREPRESENTS. Inconclusive evidence stays local.

observation_policy.scheduling: Sequential awaited work; no scheduling-dependent value is frozen
boundaries: core capturing sink: frozen canonical occurrences
delivery exchange: not exercised by P-map; delivery guarantees belong to P-E
observation_policy.failure: Baseline failure invalidates preconditions; ordinary case throw becomes its own case_aborted mismatch and continues; sticky budget exhaustion stops. Evaluation faults keep every observation.

findings.finding: Expected conditional PASS: logout and MFA FITS; contact, lockout, release and rotation STRAINED. No catalog addition under recommended defaults. #805 judges the later measurements and owner alternatives.
No registry, enum or item maxLength; objects allowed. maxItems 16 and the 8192-byte input scan are independent bounds. Tokens in this plan are test examples, not a vocabulary.

G36 permits second-factor/per-account lockout reasons but no target; an engine cannot attribute those targetless events to an account. This remains a design input for the later contract field, not evidence sufficiency on 2.1.0.

When both captures exist, the SDK preserves host-supplied request and correlation IDs on K1 and K2a, enabling a host-side join of the targetless failure to the account-resolved lock, not SDK attribution. Missing either capture makes only this finding inconclusive; #806 alone decides whether the profile forbids such joins.
Login/session creation accept tenantless; logout, contact change, lockout, release and rotation do not via their best candidates. Recorded as a finding, not resolved here.

User logout uses equal actor/subject IDs and not_applicable authorization, administrator revocation uses its administrator identity and policy. No logout reason code exists. Per-path hooks can destroy equality; no new keying policy is decided.
session.revoked is transaction_critical; fail_closed before business commit can keep a compromised session alive. A capturing sink measures no durability or containment guarantee.
Lazy TTL expiry has no commit point. Automatic release would require a host-synthesized one; analysis only, no fabricated emission. U1 scheduled variant commits explicitly.

#797 removes catalog-first fallback for every no-handle non-success transaction-bound event: session.revoked, mfa.*, sensitive_resource.*, security.configuration.changed, password_reset.completed and role.* return PREMATURE_SUCCESS/validation /operation/state absent explicit commit. Direct terminal commit without a backing handle instead refuses /event/commit_state. Nontransactional authentication.failed (M1/K1) and authorization.denied (K4) retain not_applicable; those accept no-handle failure/denial honestly at the construction boundary, irrespective of semantic fit.

Every basis re-read at corrected_at. #796 cryptographic identifiers change no frozen value; #811 canonical input normalization and #816 required identified-tenant inputs change no valid construction here. #812-sensitive L5a-c/M4/U2/R1-R3 audited: only L5a outcome changes (#797). L5b direct terminal refusal, L5c denied/not_committed, M4 failure/pending refusal vs nontransactional acceptance, U2 partial/compensating/compensated and R1 missing causality/R2 genuine pair/R3 wrongly typed original remain as drafted. Line drift is basis-only, never corrected_from.
